title: Data for Canada - Statistical Data Packages
description: Statistical data packages derived from Statistics Canada's 2021 Census of Agriculture and 2021 Population Census, covering all of Canada. Includes agricultural census data on crop production, livestock counts, farm finances, land use, and farm operator demographics, as well as health workforce demographic tables. Data is aggregated to agricultural regions, census divisions, consolidated subdivisions, and aggregate dissemination areas, and delivered in cloud-native formats (Parquet, PMTiles, FlatGeobuf).
